questions.stemHtml: Sometimes, one injury to the head can cause injury to the brain at multiple places. Incorrect statement with respect to the Image given below is amongst which of the following?

options.label: A
options.text: Coup (blow; impact) means that the injury is located beneath the area of impact, and results directly from the impacting force

options.label: B
options.text: Contrecoup means that the lesion is present in an area opposite the side of the impact

options.label: C
options.text: Contrecoup injuries can also occur when a blow is struck on a fixed head

options.label: D
options.text: A line drawn between the centres of the coup and contrecoup indicates the direction of impact relative to the surface

questions.answerText: A line drawn between the centres of the coup and contrecoup indicates the direction of impact relative to the surface
questions.solutionHtml:
A line drawn between the centres of the coup and contrecoup indicates the direction of impact relative to the surface

A line drawn between the centres of the coup and contrecoup indicates the direction of impact relative to the head.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page Number: 192, 193

questions.stem: A slow-moving car swerved into an intersection and over the curb onto the sidewalk. The right front door flew open, the driver was found sprawled across the seat in a pool of vomitus. The odor of alcohol was present and the driver was observed to be ataxic and incontinent, mumbling an incoherent story. A cursory examination resulted in a diagnosis of 'drunk'. What should be done next

options.label: B
options.text: Should be kept in police custody till the court gives the verdict

options.label: C
options.text: Should be kept in police custody for the next 24 hours to observe his behavior and gestures

options.label: D
options.text: Should be shifted to the hospital

questions.answerText: Should be shifted to the hospital
questions.solutionHtml:
Should be shifted to the hospital

Head injury and acute alcoholic intoxication:

  • A person may be confused and disorientated after a head injury which may simulate acute alcoholic intoxication.
  • If an intoxicated person sustains a head injury, it may not be possible to assess to what degree his condition is due to head injury or alcoholic intoxication. Such a person should not be kept in police custody but should be admitted to a hospital for observation.


KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page Number: 195

questions.stemHtml: A person with a head injury was admitted to the emergency. After 3 days, a repeat CT head was done. The following Image gives clue about this. Which of the following?
questions.solutionHtml:
Duret hemorrhage

questions.stem: Ravi kicks Ram on his chest directly in the region of his heart. Ram succumbs due to abnormal heart rhythm. What is the term given to this?
questions.solutionHtml:
Commotio Cordis

CARDIAC CONCUSSION:-

  • A cardiac concussion can occur after a sudden forceful impact directed at the mid-anterior chest wall in the region of the heart, i.e. COMMOTIO CORDIS.
  • Death occurs due to ventricular fibrillation or asystole. The functional disturbance may be caused by reflex coronary vasoconstriction and myocardial ischemia or by abnormal autonomic responses.


KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page Number: 206

questions.stem: A person was brought with multiple fresh injuries over the body with suspicion of physical assault. Police asked for an opinion on whether the injuries are grievous. All are grievous hurts EXCEPT:

options.label: B
options.text: Incised wound on the abdominal wall without peritoneal injury

questions.answerText: Incised wound on the abdominal wall without peritoneal injury
questions.solutionHtml:
Incised wound on the abdominal wall without peritoneal injury

Incised wound on the abdominal wall without peritoneal injury’ is a simple injury. If the peritoneum had been breached, it would have been a grievous injury or maybe a dangerous injury. All other injuries- dislocation, fracture, and disfiguration are grievous injuries as per Section 320 IPC.

KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 35th Edition, Page Number: 224, 225
